The Letter is on top of all his stuff in his chest and says:
||Dear Ophelia,
    The brightest part of my day, is spending my evenings with you.  Each time I see you, my heart skips.  My pain subsides.  Simply put, you have filled a hole in me that I though unfillable.  There is much about me you still do not know, and much of you I still do not know.  But I would gladly as long as it takes to learn it.  You have made me realize; I cannot spend my life separate from others.  I cannot continue to deny that I need companionship.  Last night, I had nightmares of everyone dying, and being the last survivor again.  When I awoke, you were the first person I thought of, and realized my mind is afraid of losing you.  It is telling me I need to let you in.

Simply put, I wish to walk by you.  In whatever fashion you see fit.

-Gil||
